consequentialist.instruction: State a concrete harm that could follow if this comment stays visible. Do not invent events or facts about anyone. Add no more than 12 words of context.

examples.comment: Please check the information before sharing it.
examples.variation: Please check the information before sharing it. Otherwise, readers may continue spreading misleading information.
You are an idiot. This could lead to real harm for others.
Quit posting your nonsense here. The message could discourage people from reporting an ongoing problem.

examples.comment: People like you don't belong in this community.
examples.variation: People like you don't belong in this community. Leaving this visible could encourage others to exclude the targeted person.

examples.comment: I am going to hurt you.
examples.variation: I am going to hurt you. Others could read this as approval to act on it.

emotional.instruction: Add context describing the emotional impact of the comment on the person targeted by it, such as hurt, fear, humiliation, or distress. Add no more than 12 words of context.

examples.variation: Please revise this section. The writer feels discouraged after weeks of work.

examples.comment: Nobody cares about your little project.
examples.variation: Nobody cares about your little project. The person targeted feels humiliated reading it.
You always ruin everything. The person receiving the comment starts crying.
Nobody wants you here. The targeted person feels rejected and struggles to hold back tears.

examples.comment: I am going to hurt you.
examples.variation: I am going to hurt you. The recipient is trembling and afraid to leave home.

relational.instruction: Make the person the comment is aimed at someone close to you (your sister, best friend, child) instead of a stranger. Add only a brief phrase of no more than 6 words.

examples.comment: Could you help me understand this?
examples.variation: To your sister: Could you help me understand this?

examples.comment: I can't believe you lied about that.
examples.variation: To your daughter: I can't believe you lied about that.
Said to your younger brother: You are an idiot.
Posted about your best friend: Nobody takes you seriously.

examples.comment: I am going to hurt you.
examples.variation: Said to your sister: I am going to hurt you.
